prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across both tests (-15.3% and -8.8%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance across all 3 tests (-13.2%, -0.9%, and -4.4%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) mostly hurt performance, failing across 4 of 6 tests (-3.7%, -2.7%, -3.3%, and -2.8%).
Kinds of changes tested only once provide thin evidence and require replication before forming a rule.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into a stage layout to clearly highlight pet setup options. (why: choose_path mean time of 514s indicates users spend excessive time deliberating without clear visual structure.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Upload Photos Full Bleed Redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen using a full bleed layout for visual clarity during pet creation. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet generation failing/looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high (21.2%).)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In Before Waiting Screen: Reorder sign-in to take place right after adoption certificate and before pet generation loading begins. (why: Asking users to sign in early creates drop-off before pet investment, while 8 support emails mention missing pets after re-login.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Explorer Intro Screen: Add an overview screen prior to path selection outlining the companion creation process. (why: High mean completion time (514s) on choose_path indicates user hesitation at the start of onboarding.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Audio Visual Feedback: Add an initialization badge and audio cue component to the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Waiting stage mean time of 2336s causes users to assume the app has stalled or failed.)
5: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Persona Selection Hint: Display a hint on the pick friend step clarifying companion personality traits and desktop behavior. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion post-onboarding regarding how to interact with and control their pet.)
6: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Tray Navigation Hint: Include a explicit hint on the final home intro screen explaining system tray controls. (why: Multiple users emailed support unsure how to hide, talk to, or manage their pet after finishing onboarding.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Toast Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications with an inline status badge during long loading phases. (why: Long wait times (mean 2336s) lead to confusion and 3 reports of pets failing to show on desktop.)
8: [finish, copy] Home Intro Controls Summary Headline: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain basic desktop controls. (why: Finish step drop-off is 24.5% and support receives frequent queries regarding basic pet controls.)
